record_title: Sharp asymptotics and Gaussian profile for weighted-representation partitions
scientific_context: For the Yang--Chen weighted representation partition count, this record sharpens the recent correct-order estimate to an asymptotic equivalence with an explicit constant and proves a Gaussian profile when the eventual representation difference is of square-root size.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result keeps k fixed and assumes c_T/sqrt(T) has a finite limit; it does not establish uniformity for growing k, a moderate- or large-deviation theorem, or an optimized error term. The 2012 Yang--Chen paper was not fully inspected, although the 2026 primary source reports its relevant counting result as substantially coarser. Very recent concurrent work may not yet be indexed. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact construction of the finite sign system, exact finite counts, covariance checks, parity checks, and comparisons with the predicted local-limit constants.
Deterministic output of verify.py for representative fixed-difference and square-root-scale cases.
